children: Finland digital design firm's Q2 revenue fell 10% yr/yr to EUR 4.1 mln
Company posted Q2 net loss of EUR 1.2 mln, with EBITDA loss widening
CEO cites tough Nordic market, pricing pressure and weak demand for revenue decline
Digitalist Group expects 2026 turnover to decrease compared to 2025
Company expects 2026 EBITDA to improve versus 2025 but remain negative
Company says competition and pricing pressure expected to continue limiting growth and profitability
PRICING PRESSURE - Co said strong competition in Nordic markets led to low hourly rates, especially in Finland and the public sector, limiting growth and pressuring profitability
COST SAVINGS - Operating expense savings offset some impact from lower turnover, but were not enough to restore profitability
MARKET CONDITIONS - Both Finnish and Swedish operations declined due to challenging market conditions
